create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
set_and_get_graph_weights: set graph arc weights using a list or numpy array and retrieve them as a list or numpy array
create_scalar_graph: create a scalar graph from a single weight value using gtn.scalar_graph for differentiable computation
run_backward_on_graph_operations: run backward pass on gtn.add or gtn.negate results to compute gradients on input graphs
compare_and_save_load_graphs: compare two graphs for equality or isomorphism and save or load graphs to and from disk
